names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 18 Ιανουαρίου, «Όσιος Μαρκιανός», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the title on his name link behind the line for 2 ноября ст. ст., «Преподобный Маркиан Кирский», with the rank word left off, and repeated as the title of both of his life pages. The day's own line declines the name and gives a different by-name, «Маркиана Киринейского».

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 2. новембар ст. ст., „Преп. Маркијан Кирски.“ — «Преп.» is the `venerable` grade `types` keeps. «Кирски» is the adjective of Кир, the city of Cyrrhus the body says he came from, and it is NOT governed by a rank word here, so unlike the see in «еп. Патавски» on the same day it does not come off with one; it is left off all the same, because the form stored is the bare personal name and «of Cyrrhus» in the display name is this corpus’s own English for the same city, off the Russian «Маркиан Кирский» and saint.gr’s notice. AUTHOR: the two headings of this one day pull opposite ways on a toponymic — one governed by «еп.» and one standing alone — and a ruling on whether a free-standing toponymic belongs in a stored `sr` form would settle a shape that recurs most days. `sr-foldpred.mjs` measured the bare string as held by four folders, so this form takes that fold to five and the key is in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs`.

feast.note: Both of his life pages head themselves «Дни памяти: 18 января , 2 ноября», and the 18 января is the day saint.gr keeps him on. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it. days.pravoslavie.ru's own page for 18 января ст. ст. was not read (4 October 2026), and the Julian 18 January of this corpus was written by an earlier reader without a row for him.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 2 ноября ст. ст. — «Прп. Маркиана Киринейского (388).»

attestations.note: The line's «Прп.» is venerable, which this folder already held from saint.gr's «Όσιος». **The line's by-name and the name link's disagree**: the line reads «Маркиана Киринейского», of Cyrene, while the name page and both of its life pages read «Маркиан Кирский», of Cyrrhus, and the second life opens with the desert «близ города Кира». The fuller and repeated form is kept and the line's word is recorded here; that this is the man saint.gr gave the corpus is read off the see, the solitude, the two disciples and the shared 18 January. The place is a by-name and not a rank, so neither word reaches `office`.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 18ης Ιανουαρίου — «Όσιος Μαρκιανός»

attestations.note: The same day page carries a ΣΗΜΕΙΩΣΗ saying that some synaxaristae mention his memory here superfluously and referring the reader to 2 November: «Περιττώς αναφέρεται από ορισμένους συναξαριστές η μνήμη του Oσίου Μαρκιανού (βλέπε 2 Νοεμβρίου).» The line is nonetheless printed in the day's list, and the row records the day page that was read.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 15.11.2025 (2. новембар ст. ст.) — „Преп. Маркијан Кирски.“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, one man, nine sentences, and the FIRST LIFE this folder has had beyond the Greek notice and the Russian line. Quoted whole with its closing full stop (section 4); URL year 2025. `types`: `venerable` and `hermit` UNTOUCHED and both confirmed — «Преп.» is the venerable grade and «повукао се у пустињу Халкидску на подвиг отшелнички» the hermit — AND `wonderworker` IS ADDED, off «Чудотворац велики за живота и по смрти», a great wonderworker in life and after death, which is section 5’s «Чудотворац» and a type this corpus already holds. `dates` WIDENED from a flat 388 to 387–388: the entry closes «Упокојио се у Господу 387. год.» where days.pravoslavie.ru prints «(388)» on its line and «Скончался в 388 г.» in one life and «около 388 года» in another. One year apart, two books, nothing chosen. NO `office`: «Из града Кира у Сирији» is where he came from and not a see he held, and he held none — he was a hermit. NO `locations`: Cyrrhus in Syria and the desert of Chalcis are both named and this folder has never held the key; a located saint with no second coordinate buys `map-span.test.mjs` and nothing else. NO `related` ROW, AND FOUR PEOPLE ARE NAMED. «Савременик патријарха Флавијана Антиохијског и царева: Констанција и Валента» — Flavian of Antioch and the emperors Constantius and Valens are a dating device and not a relation, and the corpus holds no Flavian of Antioch; its `flavian-of-constantinople` is a different see and a different man and no row claims otherwise. The disciple «Јевсевије», whom he ordered to hide and secretly bury his body because of the many who venerated him, is the one person in the entry who stands in a relation to him — AND THE CORPUS HOLDS ELEVEN EUSEBII AND NOT ONE OF THEM IS SAID BY ANY PAGE READ TO BE THIS DISCIPLE, so no row is made and he is named in the prose only. THE FOLD: `sr-foldpred.mjs` measured «Маркијан» as held by `marcian-companion-of-martyrius`, `marcian-of-constantinople`, `marcian-of-durostorum` and `marcian-of-the-brazen-gate`, so this form takes that fold to five; the key is in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs` and the four-member key it replaces is deleted there. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

death.note: **Two books one year apart, and the interval holds both; it was a flat 388 before this reading.** saint.gr gave no year of birth and none of death. days.pravoslavie.ru prints «(388)» on the line, closes its first life «Скончался в 388 г.» and closes its second life of the same man on the same page «Скончался в мире около 388 года», about 388; the flat year is the one printed on the day line and was taken. The Охридски пролог for 2. новембар ст. ст. closes its entry «Упокојио се у Господу 387. год.» — he reposed in the Lord in the year 387. Nothing is chosen, and the basis stays traditional for the hedge as well as for the disagreement. Both books open him in the fourth century.
